portable_job_lease.name: portable_job_lease
portable_job_lease.value: CASE WHEN "portable_jobs"."status" IN ('running','dispatching') THEN "portable_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "portable_jobs"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL ELSE "portable_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "portable_jobs"."lease_until" IS NULL END

portable_workflow_run_source.name: portable_workflow_run_source
portable_workflow_run_source.value:
("portable_workflow_runs"."deal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "portable_workflow_runs"."deal_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "portable_workflow_runs"."contact_id" IS NULL AND "portable_workflow_runs"."contact_revision" IS NULL)
    OR ("portable_workflow_runs"."deal_id" IS NULL AND "portable_workflow_runs"."deal_revision" IS NULL AND "portable_workflow_runs"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL AND "portable_workflow_runs"."contact_revision" IS NOT NULL)

portable_task_completion.name: portable_task_completion
portable_task_completion.value:
"portable_tasks"."data"->>'status' IS NOT NULL AND
    (("portable_tasks"."data"->>'status' = 'Completed' AND "portable_tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("portable_tasks"."data"->>'status' = 'Not started' AND "portable_tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL))
